properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Prompted 2026-10-26 by a designer agent on a sample shop design: "There is no way to record an owed action by an outside party; I used planned checks instead" (it recorded e.g. a Verification, method review, status planned, named "OWED (county hearings examiner ...)", who and what only in prose).

WHAT EXISTS IN v0.92.0, each a piece and none the whole: a Contributor of kind `organization` (who, but a Contributor is an author of the design); OWNED_BY (read only as "gaps on your ground"); a Question with `asked_of` (a question, not an action, and no date); SCHEDULED_FOR to a DesignEpoch or Release with modality `required` (a date only as an epoch); GATED_ON (TRL/MRL only); an Actor (stakeholder / external_system, no edge meaning "owes"); an Interface with medium `procedural` and designation `required` (the contract, not the pending act); a follow-up TemporalFact (our own to-do).

OPTIONS, none chosen:
(a) NOTHING NEW: a convention — planned Verification + OWNED_BY an organization Contributor + SCHEDULED_FOR an epoch — documented in a skill, and a loop read that lists planned checks owned by an outside party as "owed by them".
(b) A Question put to an outside party (asked_of an organization) gains `due` and a kind `action`, so open_questions/loop_status already carry it.
(c) A new edge, e.g. OWES (Actor or Contributor → the node it settles) with `due`, `what`, `requested_at`, read by loop_status and closure as owed-outside and never as design debt.
(d) Leave it to the host (flo2) as a task list beside the design.

PUSHBACK KEPT: every new node or edge type has to earn its place against the vocabulary-is-closed discipline; (a) may be enough if a reader exists. An outside party's act often CLOSES a breach (a variance), so it should link to the violation it would settle. A date-valued deadline is not an epoch, and reflow2 deliberately keeps delivery computed rather than asserted.
properties.name: OPEN — how does a design record an action OWED BY SOMEONE OUTSIDE IT (an engineer's deferred submittal, a county's ruling, a utility's approval), with who owes it, what it settles and by when, so the loop reads it as owed by them rather than as a check that never ran?
properties.rationale: Kept so the encoding is chosen deliberately; a design heading for a permit has several such owed acts, and today they read as unexecuted checks. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
